home.heroDesc: Report problems in your area and track how they are being addressed. A direct, transparent channel between citizens and administration to build better communities together.

workflow.subtitle: Transparent Redressal Workflow
workflow.title: How It Works
workflow.step1Desc: Submit an issue using Image, Text, or Voice formats to ensure accurate and detailed reporting directly to relevant civic authorities.
workflow.step2Desc: Automated AI severity scoring and municipal verification ensure grievances are directed to the correct jurisdictional department within SLA.
workflow.step3Desc: Track real-time field team dispatches, milestone updates, photographic proof of work, and verify resolution satisfaction.

categories.subtitle: Direct Civic Channels
categories.title: Priority Redressal Areas
categories.roadDesc: Potholes, broken footpaths, road cracks, road signs and street maintenance.
categories.waterDesc: Blocked sewer lines, contaminated tap water, low pressure or pipeline bursts.
categories.electricityDesc: Non-functional street lamps, damaged transformers, live wires and power cuts.
categories.safetyDesc: Traffic signal malfunctions, uncovered manholes, stray hazards and dark alleys.
categories.wasteDesc: Garbage dumping, overflowing community bins, open debris and sanitation.
categories.environmentDesc: Fallen trees, encroachment in public parks, and urban garden maintenance.

cta.title: Have an urgent civic issue in your neighborhood?

submit.pageSubtitle: Direct digital submission to state municipal and civic authority systems.
submit.unifiedSubtitle: Submit your grievance using any combination of text, voice recording, or photos.
submit.unifiedPlaceholder: Describe your problem in detail (e.g. location, severity, duration, safety hazards)...
submit.atLeastOneRequired: Please provide at least one input: describe your problem, record a voice note, or attach a photo.

methods.voiceDesc: Speak in Hindi, Odia, or English

submit.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Deep pothole causing two-wheeler accidents
submit.descPlaceholder: Describe the location, severity, duration, and safety risk...
submit.locationPlaceholder: e.g. Near Main Market Gate #2, Sector 4
submit.photoUploadDesc: Upload clear images showing the exact problem and surroundings (JPG, PNG, WebP up to 10MB)
submit.mapPinDesc: Click or drag the marker on the map to pinpoint exact coordinates for field inspection teams.
submit.reviewSubtitle: Please verify all information before official submission into the central queue.
submit.ackNotice: A digital acknowledgement tracking token will be issued immediately upon submission.
